category_semantics: Categories describe observed tool interfaces, not inferred intent or optimal action.

no_call_audit.interpretation: No-call records are audited for finality, reasoning, content, finish fields, malformed, and ambiguous structure; none are retained.

near_duplicate_audit.method: retained task text; lowercase alphanumeric whitespace normalization; cross-split set-token Jaccard >= 0.85; max 100 recorded pairs

policy.history: newest complete rendered prefix messages that fit, restored to source chronology
policy.loss: optional older prefix history only; target turn, later events, gold, and provenance metadata are never renderer inputs

sample_review.method: lowest stable id in every populated category for train and dev; direct source-target adjudication
sample_review.qualitative_status: VERIFIED structural label/source agreement; semantic intent remains UNKNOWN

scope: Completed tool-bearing target turns with a structurally complete prefix and exactly one mapped tool-interface category; every no-call target is excluded because positive completion evidence is unavailable.

source.semantic_basis: README.source.md lines 81-86 and 127-130 describe cumulative targets; no-call targets are excluded because the source exposes no positive completion marker
